summary: FB Financial Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $125 million offering of 6.625% fixed-to-floating rate subordinated notes due 2036. The notes pay a fixed 6.625% semi-annually through October 1, 2031, then float at Three-Month Term SOFR plus 205 bps quarterly. Priced at 100.00%, underwriter discounts of 1.25% yield $123.4 million net proceeds; settlement is T+3 on September 24, 2026. The notes are unsecured, subordinated, non-convertible, unlisted, and redeemable from October 1, 2031, subject to Federal Reserve approval. This routine Tier 2 capital raise is not a special situation.
